record.destination: A brand-new user or brand-new agent can learn nahel without reading source: every verb answers --help with exit 0, a checked-in how-to doc lists all CLI verbs and /nd:* workflow commands with when-to-use guidance, questions about an individual command are answerable from the help surface alone, and the docs cannot silently drift from the code as verbs and workflows change.

payload.body: Origin: Devin agent probed 'nahel log --help' as its first act (PR #27 review). 2026-08-19 Jim (AFK delegation, journal event m246ffk6): attach the researched verb+workflow inventory here, generate a how-to doc, plan doc freshness, study Matt Pocock's ask-matt skill for the ask-about-a-command use case. Inventory research already done in-session: 25 CLI verbs in src/cli.ts COMMANDS registry (descriptions live there), 18 canonical workflows in nahel/workflows/*.md (name/description/args frontmatter), shims generated by nahel install. Both surfaces are machine-readable — freshness by generation is the obvious candidate.
